name: RecordingsSummarize routes Chat::Lines::Text (recording type) through Campfire discovery and projects the line
description: A chat line by recording type — any Chat::Lines::* subtype — takes the same discovery path as chat.line.created: the bucket's project dock (404 here: not a project), then the account-wide listing filtered to the bucket, then the line under each candidate in listing order until one answers. The projection carries the line's type, id, status, title, app_url, content, mentions (none: a plain text line's content is not rich text), the nested identities by id, updated_at as an instant, and campfire_id — the Campfire it was found under, the reply destination. Part of the routing matrix a port must implement.

name: RecordingsSummarize refuses boost.created before any request
description: boost.created names no recording type (the row points at the boost's target, whose type it does not carry), so the helper refuses it distinctly rather than reading something it is not. No request is made. The error is the composite's own identity (no_recording_type), which a consumer matches rather than parses.

name: RecordingsSummarize finds a chat line under the second visible Campfire
description: A chat line's read needs its Campfire, which the pointer does not carry. The bucket is not a project (its dock read 404s), so the candidates come from the account-wide Campfire listing filtered to the bucket; the line is tried under each in listing order until one answers, and the Campfire in the other bucket is never tried. Nested identities — bucket, creator, and where the type has them parent and first assignee — are pinned by id. updated_at is pinned as an instant (RFC 3339 values compare by time, not by rendering).

name: RecordingsSummarize reports a chat line under no visible Campfire as unresolved, not as a failed read
description: Every candidate answered 404, so the line is under no Campfire the caller can see. That is its own error, distinct from a read that failed, so a consumer can block the record and retry later rather than treat it as an outage. errorType pins the identity: recording_unresolved, not a not_found or forbidden read and not campfire_discovery_incomplete.

name: RecordingsSummarize returns a Campfire candidate's 403 as that read's error
description: Any answer but 404 from a candidate stops the loop and is returned as that error: a permission failure never masquerades as "not here", and the next candidate is not tried.

name: CommentsCreateWithMentions resolves each person before posting and writes the mention from attachable_sgid
description: A mention is a bc-attachment whose sgid is the person's attachable_sgid. Each id is read through the people read first, so a failed lookup posts nothing; the tag is placed inside the content's first block.
